incident_text: A large smoke column over the fields, probably a grass fire. Nobody is nearby.

result.scene_summary: A large plume of smoke rises from a distant field over a flat, open landscape with a fence in the foreground.

observations.description: A large, dense plume of smoke dominates the sky, originating from the horizon.
A wide, flat field of dry, golden-brown grass covers the landscape.
A wire fence with metal posts is visible in the mid-ground.
Small dark shapes, possibly animals, are visible in the distant field.
